verdict.rationale: BVNK supports a concrete rules API (POST /payment/v1/rules) that automatically links fiat virtual accounts to crypto blockchain addresses, and webhooks provide event-driven notifications that can trigger downstream automated actions. However, this is limited to a narrow, specific use case (fiat-to-crypto linking) rather than a general-purpose rules engine for arbitrary event-triggered actions across the platform. Missing for 10: a broader/generalized rules engine covering multiple event types and actions, and independent/hands-on confirmation of automation-depth beyond docs.
